findings.highlight: "Don't talk to me right now. I'm basking in the afterglow."
findings.evidenceJa:
「話しかけるな。
余韻に浸れない」
findings.explanation: Chiaki says talking to her prevents her from soaking in the afterglow; the English states simply that she is basking in it.
